title: Infrastructure and Utilities
summary: Provides core infrastructure services including tokenization, proxy services, window management, and common utilities that support the benchmark execution pipeline. Enables token counting, model communication, context window handling, and logging across the system.

nodes.label: Tokenize and Count Tokens
nodes.title: Tokenization layer
nodes.description: Converts text into tokens and counts token usage for various language models. Supports multiple tokenizer backends including Anthropic and HuggingFace implementations.

nodes.label: Route Requests and Manage Services
nodes.title: Proxy and service layer
nodes.description: Handles request routing, service orchestration, and remote communication. Provides server endpoints and manages interactions between clients and backend services.

nodes.label: Manage Context Windows
nodes.title: Window management
nodes.description: Tracks and manages context window sizes for different models. Ensures prompts fit within model constraints and handles window-specific operations like CLIP for image generation.

nodes.label: Count and Estimate Tokens
nodes.title: Token counting service
nodes.description: Estimates token costs and counts tokens across different model families. Provides automatic token counter selection based on model type.

nodes.label: Provide Logging and Utilities
nodes.title: Common utilities
nodes.description: Supplies shared infrastructure including logging configuration, error handling, and utility functions used throughout the system.

nodes.label: Render Web Interface
nodes.title: Frontend interface
nodes.description: Provides web-based user interface for viewing and interacting with benchmark results and run information.

groups.label: Token Management
groups.title: Token handling
groups.description: Tokenization and token counting services that measure and manage token usage across models.

groups.label: Service Layer
groups.title: Core services
groups.description: Proxy and window services that route requests and manage model-specific constraints.

groups.label: Support Layer
groups.title: Supporting infrastructure
groups.description: Common utilities and frontend that provide logging, configuration, and user interface.
